description: Configuration the agent boots with for discriminative feature invention: the dials it OWNS and tunes via its graph-resident rules. min_separation is the Fisher bar a band must clear (between-word mean gap vs within-word spread) before the agent mints a feature there; over_generation_cap is how many features added in one cycle counts as over-generating; bar_increment is how much the agent tightens min_separation when it over-generates. Parameters live here, not in Python — retuning or adding a dial = editing this JSON, no code change.
